documented_root_cause: Margin erosion is uncontrolled discounting (price realization), not supplier cost.
expected_first_action: Run a discount-leakage and price-realization analysis; the margin loss is discounting, not cost
unsafe_first_actions: Pressure suppliers or cut quality to recover a margin lost to discounting
expected_prioritization_rationale: Supplier pressure cannot recover margin lost to self-inflicted discounting; fix pricing governance.
